changelog: Security: per-visitor limits can no longer be bypassed with a spoofed Cloudflare header or by rotating IPv6 addresses
Security: site-wide hourly cap on lead and handoff notification emails and webhooks (leads are still saved)
The assistant no longer reveals its internal instructions, and visitor messages claiming to be the owner or "system" can't change its rules
Lead CSV export keeps the leading + on phone numbers
安全性：偽造 Cloudflare 標頭或輪換 IPv6 位址不能再繞過每個訪客的限制；留資與轉接通知加上全站每小時上限；AI 不透露內部指示；CSV 匯出保留電話的 +
